log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon
|-status|p1a: Dragonite|brn|[from] ability: Flame Body|[of] p2a: Volcarona

decisions.thought: Mirror match vs scripted bot. Plan: lead Scarf Garchomp (outspeeds everything except opposing Scarf Garchomp/Volcarona tie), Gholdengo for Nasty Plot sweeping, Dragonite as Multiscale cleaner. Watch for their Volcarona Quiver Dance; keep Garchomp's Rock Slide ready.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Mirror match. Lead Garchomp scarf outspeeds most; bring Garchomp, Gholdengo, Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Lead Garchomp vs Primarina. Scarf Poison Jab is super effective and likely 2HKO; locks me into it, fine vs Primarina. Their remaining two unknown—watch for Volcarona (Rock Slide) and Kingambit (EQ). Gholdengo/Dragonite clean late.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Poison Jab super effective on Primarina, Scarf locks it. Poison Jab 80 BP SE = 160 effective vs EQ 100 neutral. Poison Jab better.

decisions.thought: Garchomp died to Moonblast. Primarina at 31%, Torrent active—Water moves boosted. Gholdengo resists Fairy and Water, walls Primarina; send it in, then Make It Rain to finish. Dragonite saved as cleaner with Multiscale intact. Their last two unknown; watch for Volcarona/Kingambit.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Primarina at 31%, Torrent boosted. Gholdengo resists Moonblast and Water. Send Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: Primarina at 31%, Torrent active. Gholdengo resists Fairy/Water and outspeeds; Make It Rain should KO. Remaining two foes unknown (possibly Volcarona/Kingambit/Garchomp). Dragonite kept healthy as cleaner. If they switch, Make It Rain still chunks most targets.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Make It Rain kills Primarina at 31%. Just attack.

decisions.thought: Volcarona in vs my -2 Gholdengo; Make It Rain resisted, Shadow Ball weak, and it may Quiver Dance. Switch to Dragonite: Multiscale intact, resists Fire/Bug, ExtremeSpeed revenge-kills. Gholdengo stays healthy for later vs their last mon (possibly Kingambit/Garchomp). If Volcarona QDs as I switch, ExtremeSpeed still chunks it.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Volcarona threatens Quiver Dance sweep. Gholdengo at -2 SpA; Shadow Ball is neutral, Make It Rain resisted. Volcarona may outspeed. Dragonite with Multiscale + ExtremeSpeed handles Volcarona well. Switch to Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Volcarona at 100%, Multiscale broken (161/166). Dragonite resists Fire/Bug; Giga Drain was weak. ExtremeSpeed (~45%) twice should KO; it likely can't KO me back. If it Quiver Dances, keep spamming ExtremeSpeed. Gholdengo healthy in back for their last mon (Kingambit/Garchomp/Dragonite/Gholdengo).
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Volcarona at 100%, Dragonite at 161/166 (not full, Multiscale broken). ExtremeSpeed 80 BP vs Volcarona ~160-192 HP, 204 Atk: does ~40-50%. Not a KO. Volcarona may Quiver Dance. If it QDs, it outspeeds and could sweep... but its moves: Giga Drain revealed; likely Fiery Dance/Bug Buzz. Dragonite resists both. ExtremeSpeed chunks. Plan: Dragon Dance? Risky if it attacks. Actually ExtremeSpeed twice likely KOs; it can't KO Dragonite easily (resists Fire/Bug, Giga Drain weak). Just ExtremeSpeed.

decisions.thought: Volcarona at 51%; first ExtremeSpeed did ~47%, so a second should KO (Flame Body burn risk, but Lum is gone—accept it). Gholdengo healthy in back for their last mon (Kingambit/Garchomp/Dragonite/Gholdengo). If Volcarona survives and Quiver Dances, keep spamming ExtremeSpeed.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: ExtremeSpeed did ~47% at full; Volcarona at 51%, another ES should KO. Just attack.

decisions.thought: Their last mon is Gholdengo at 100%. Dragonite's EQ (204 Atk, super effective) likely OHKOes or near-OHKOes. Risk: if their Gholdengo is max speed (149) it outspeeds and Make It Rain hurts, but Dragonite at 150/166 should survive one hit. If Dragonite falls, my healthy Gholdengo with Shadow Ball cleans up the mirror.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragonite vs Gholdengo: Earthquake is super effective, 204 Atk vs ~115 Def. EQ likely OHKO or near. But if they outspeed (max 149 > 130), Make It Rain could hurt. Dragonite at 150/166, Multiscale broken. EQ from 204 Atk vs 103-161 Def: likely OHKO. Their Make It Rain vs Dragonite 124 SpD: ~50-60%? Risky but EQ is the play. Alternatively switch to my Gholdengo—Make It Rain vs their Gholdengo: Steel resists Steel... Make It Rain is Steel, they resist. Shadow Ball super effective. Mirror: my Gholdengo 147 Spe vs theirs up to 149. Shadow Ball 80 BP vs 115 SpD won't OHKO. Dragonite EQ is stronger. Go EQ.

decisions.thought: Their Gholdengo at 11%; Extreme Speed is useless (Ghost immune). Earthquake KOs through Leftovers. Even if they outspeed and Make It Rain, Dragonite at 150/166 survives, and my healthy Gholdengo with Shadow Ball cleans up regardless. Just EQ.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Their Gholdengo at 11%, Extreme Speed is immune (Ghost). Earthquake KOs. If they outspeed and Make It Rain, Dragonite survives. EQ it.
